tessa wu: Quick PR to add a dedicated provisioning checklist for customers migrating from legacy labels. Link: https://git/repo/pulls/5101
liam ong: Can we include a minimal end-to-end example: create tenant -> reserve pool -> attach policy -> migrate labels? Ops needs exact commands.
nina patel: I'll paste a tiny workflow and a rollback line. Keep it short, this will be a bullet list in the handbook.

# minimal migration workflow (for docs)
1) create tenant yaml (new-format)
2) reserve pool: `redwoodctl dedicated reserve --pool small-test`
3) apply policy via SDK or CLI
4) migrate labels: `redwoodctl dedicated migrate-tenant --input tenant.yaml --dry-run`
5) apply when happy: `--apply`

liam ong: note: mention SDK/CLI version requirements (SDK >= 0.9.3, CLI >= 1.12.0). Also call out: "transient throttling <2m" during label propagation.
docs-bot: Lint: add cross-link to /handbook/dedicated/migration.md and include changelog entry.
